ModMetaData.name: Colony Task Auditor
ModMetaData.author: pengin0503
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld 1.7 stalled-work diagnostics for construction, mining, production, farming and animal gathering. Explains material, worker, access and reservation blockers with confidence levels; offers cause-specific navigation, individually confirmed bill resume and target unforbid, watched high-priority tasks and optional bounded temporary vanilla priority requests. It never forces a job or changes work-table values. Requires Harmony. New 1.1.0 gameplay behavior has not been verified in normal play.
RimWorld 1.7向けの停滞作業診断MODです。建築・採掘・製造・農作業・家畜資源の作業を監視し、材料・作業者・到達性・予約などの原因を確信度付きで表示します。原因別の対象移動、確認付きの製造指示再開や個別禁止解除、重要作業の監視と任意の期限付き優先依頼に対応します。Jobを強制発行せず、作業表の数値も変更しません。Harmonyが必要です。1.1.0の新機能は通常プレイでは未検証です。
